llm_response.reason: The site mimics legitimate BGMI branding and offers rare/free in-game items as bait, pushing users to log in with social accounts—classic credentials phishing. The domain is recently registered, not associated with the official publisher Krafton, uses privacy-protected WHOIS, and provides ambiguous privacy policy links. The site uses urgency and verification language to exploit psychological weaknesses and does not provide verifiable business contact information, all of which are strong scam indicators from the provided list.
